### Added

- Run Dex from the Giant Swarm Dex line, 2.46.0-gs.1 in [#554](https://github.com/giantswarm/dex-app/pull/554) by [@The127](https://github.com/The127)
- Add architecture value for arm64 node pools in [#565](https://github.com/giantswarm/dex-app/pull/565) by [@stone-z](https://github.com/stone-z)
- Support connector maps and referenced connector secrets in [#566](https://github.com/giantswarm/dex-app/pull/566) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- Run the Giant Swarm Dex image and ship the login pages in the chart in [#574](https://github.com/giantswarm/dex-app/pull/574) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)

### Fixed

- Require connector Secrets, accept existing connector lists and extra client maps in [#571](https://github.com/giantswarm/dex-app/pull/571) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/dex-app/compare/v3.4.24...v3.5.0
